as_told.title: Watchers lust after and procreate with human women

tellings.quote: And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters.
And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: ‘Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.’

And they were in all two hundred; who descended ⌜in the days⌝ of =Jared= on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.

And all the others together with them took unto themselves wives, and each chose for himself one, and they began to go in unto them and to defile themselves with them, and they taught them charms and enchantments, and the cutting of roots, and made them acquainted with plants.
And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells:
And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

plain: An ancient story says that beings from heaven came down, took human wives and fathered giants, and several people on the show bring it up as a possible early memory of visitors from somewhere else. Michels himself recalls that in the Book of Enoch, an old Jewish religious text left out of most Bibles, 'the watchers' mated with humans and 'there were giants in the earth in those days'. The podcaster Joe Rogan, crediting a member of Congress named Anna Paulina Luna, reads the tale as a kind of genetic engineering: the Watchers 'came down and bred with men and created the Nephilim', the name for their giant children. A guest named Jay Anderson notes that the beings came down on Mount Hermon, which he places in Lebanon, and a researcher named Tim Alberino says their first sin was lust, 'they lusted after the daughters of men', which he ties to Genesis 6. The book itself, in R. H. Charles's English translation of 1917, has angels, 'the children of the heaven', see beautiful women and say 'let us choose us wives from among the children of men'. Two hundred of them descend in the days of Jared 'on the summit of Mount Hermon', and the women bear 'great giants'. Genesis, in the King James Bible of 1611, holds the core in a few verses: 'the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair', and 'There were giants in the earth in those days'. The Watchers, their number and the mountain belong only to Enoch's fuller telling, and reading Genesis's 'sons of God' as those same beings is the step the tellers take, which the short Genesis passage neither states nor excludes.

discussion.by: The King James Version of the Bible
discussion.text: Genesis 6 holds the core of the story in a few verses: "the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives", and "There were giants in the earth in those days", when "the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men". The Watchers, their number and Mount Hermon belong to the Book of Enoch's fuller telling, which the tellers name; reading Genesis's sons of God as those same beings is the step the tellers take with Enoch, which the short Genesis passage neither states nor excludes.
